Company Overview 
 At Motorola Solutions, we believe that everything starts with our people. We’re a global close-knit community, united by the relentless pursuit to help keep people safer everywhere. We build and connect technologies to help protect people, property and places. Our solutions foster the collaboration that’s critical for safer communities, safer schools, safer hospitals, safer businesses, and ultimately, safer nations. Connect with a career that matters, and help us build a safer future.
 
 Department Overview 
We are the Critical Communications Networks group. Every day we design, build, deploy and integrate communications systems for customers who depend on having the right information at the right time.

We look for the most advanced problem solvers - like you - to help us create technologies that rise to the challenges of our customers. To connect firefighters to police officers to emergency responders to nurses to specialists to lives saved. To protect communities, grow businesses and make work safer and more efficient.

Bring your talent to the Critical Communications Networks team as we create and improve applications to enhance device usage and integration with the larger portfolio of Motorola Solutions products. The software developer will be a member of a team working on applications our customers use to communicate and administrators use to configure and maintain customer systems. The position is available with our team in Schaumburg or Chicago. 
Job Description
 We are seeking smart, self-motivated software engineers to be responsible for designing, developing, unit testing, and integrating software to support the development, enhancement, and maintenance of elements of the telecommunication infrastructure. 
 The employee will need to closely collaborate with other teams across our global organization. To be successful in this role you must value teamwork and communication as well as working closely with other engineers in small, dynamic, Agile teams.

 Qualifications:
 Bachelor's degree or Master's degree in Computer Science, Computer Engineering, or a related technical discipline 
 At least 2+ years of professional software development experience preferred 
 Foundational programming skills including understanding of software development principles, data structures and algorithms
 Practical experience (internships, co-ops, or academic projects) developing in a structured, strongly typed language preferably Java. 
 Practical experience using a scripting language such as Python and/or Bash
 Exposure to DevOps, continuous integration, and automation environments (eg. Jenkins, Ansible)
 Practical knowledge of using a version control system like Git/Bitbucket
 Exposure to telecommunications technologies and network protocols (TCP/IP, TLS, UDP)
 Able to break-down product or system level problems into sub-problems that are addressed with innovative designs
 Able to communicate ideas to peer engineers and direct managers clearly and concisely
 
 Target Base Salary Range: $80,000 - $100,000 USD
 Consistent with Motorola Solutions values ​​and applicable law, we provide the following information to promote pay transparency and equity. Pay within this range varies and depends on job-related knowledge, skills, and experience. The actual offer will be based on the individual candidate.

 #LI-RS1

 
Basic Requirements
 Bachelor's degree or Master's degree in Computer Science, Computer Engineering, or a related technical discipline 
 Legal authorization to work in the U.S. indefinitely is required. Employer work permit sponsorship is not available for this position.

 Our U.S. Benefits include: 
 Incentive Bonus Plans

 Employee Stock Purchase Plan

 Paid Parental & Family Leave

 and more!

 
 EEO Statement 
 
 Motorola Solutions is an Equal Opportunity Employer. All qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to race, color, religion or belief, sex, sexual orientation, gender identity, national origin, disability, veteran status or any other legally-protected characteristic.  
 
 We are proud of our people-first and community-focused culture, empowering every Motorolan to be their most authentic self and to do their best work to deliver on the promise of a safer world. If you’d like to join our team but feel that you don’t quite meet all of the preferred skills, we’d still love to hear why you think you’d be a great addition to our team. 
 
 We’re committed to providing an inclusive and accessible recruiting experience for candidates with disabilities, or other physical or mental health conditions. To request an accommodation, please complete this  Reasonable Accommodations Form  so we can assist you.
